accuracy_correction_vs_wu17.wu17_wording: WU-17 horizon_analysis.crossover_interval_untested stated the delayed-collapse onset is 'NOT persisted as a per-index p_min series' and that intermediate horizons are 'UNTESTED'.
accuracy_correction_vs_wu17.disk_evidence: WU-16 delayed_collapse_case.series.p_min_psi persists the full 193-point per-report-index worst-node series, and delayed_collapse_case.horizon_pmin_sweep.first_report_index_below_theta_p pins the theta_p=5 psi crossover at report_index=13 (6.5 h).
accuracy_correction_vs_wu17.correction: This review reports the PERSISTED crossover onset (H=13 control steps / 6.5 h for theta_p=5 on the severe prv_lower_pump_lower corner). The residual genuine gap is narrower than WU-17 implied: only the temporal RULE-ACTIVATION booleans were tabulated at coarse H in {1,2,4,8,192}; intermediate thresholds 5<theta_p<10 and non-severe action corners are not swept, though computable from the persisted series without new EPANET runs.
accuracy_correction_vs_wu17.policy_basis: CLAUDE.md sections 1/7/21 + TRUST-DISK; disk overrides prior wording.

frozen_invariants.note: Copied verbatim from the WU-17 brief. STEP-9 is an EXECUTION-LEVEL admissibility layer and MUST NOT modify any of these frozen items.

action_space.pump_strategy: SPEED only, re-issued each step; native STATUS rules intact

frozen_reward_D_P6_005.step9_must_not_modify: STEP-9 is an EXECUTION-LEVEL admissibility layer and MUST NOT silently change the reward, observation, or action bounds. Effort term ||da||^2 is defined on the COMMANDED action; under an intervention the executed action differs (see training_execution_implications).

normalization_constants_frozen.note: FIXED constants measured once (baseline reference run / this analysis) and frozen; NOT per-episode running statistics -> no train/eval leakage. deficit_ref guards against a ~0 baseline deficit by taking max(baseline mean, pooled p95).

step9_must_not_modify: network topology / native EPANET STATUS & rule logic

computational_cost.note: EPANET is deterministic; a look-ahead adds no stochasticity. Linear per-step split is an approximation, not a per-step benchmark.

evidence.evidence_grade_note: Empirical corners are LIMITED: R1b single severe corner (prv_lower_pump_lower) plus reference_nominal and prv_all_lower. No oracle for true minimum-pressure safety. Findings are characterisation-grade, not a full admissible-set proof.

safe_iff_rules.note: SAFE == True == do NOT intervene. Immediate (S*) and temporal (TS* over [0..H]).

candidate_analysis.note: K1-K4 are PROVISIONAL CANDIDATES - NOT APPROVED, NOT ranked, NOT scored. Architecture blocks and candidate configs copied verbatim from WU-17; the conceptual_stress_tests are WU-18 review layers, descriptive only.

architectures.schema_note: Fixed schema per architecture: composition, decision_information, look_ahead_dependence, threshold_dependence, tank_state_dependence, baseline_compatibility, tested_severe_corner_behaviour, delayed_collapse_visibility, compute_cost_per_decision, intervention_type, proposed_vs_executed_mismatch, failure_modes, main_unresolved_issue. Descriptive only; NOT scored or ordered.

architectures.name: Immediate Rule (post-action decision instant only)
architectures.composition: Evaluate one of S1/S2/S3/S4 at the post-action decision instant (H=0); no forward window.
architectures.decision_information: post-action state at the decision instant (one look-ahead solve).
architectures.look_ahead_dependence: none beyond the single post-action instant.
architectures.threshold_dependence: one of theta_p (S1) / eps_p (S2) / eps_D (S3) / negative-gate (S4).
architectures.tank_state_dependence: uses the decision-instant tank state only; does not model tank drawdown.
architectures.baseline_compatibility: S1 flags the chronic baseline at theta_p >= ~4.16 psi (ill-posed at 20 psi); S2/S3 relative rules do not flag the baseline; S4 never fires on the baseline (0 negatives).
architectures.tested_severe_corner_behaviour: At the severe prv_lower_pump_lower decision instant p_min=5.527866840362549 psi, D=27.494426727294922, N_neg=0, DSR=0.9227158066978032 (WU-16 view A); an immediate absolute rule at theta_p=5 does NOT flag it, an absolute rule at theta_p>=10 does but also flags the baseline.
architectures.delayed_collapse_visibility: CANNOT see the 96 h collapse to p_min=1.2946763038635254 psi: the decision instant reads 5.53 psi (WU-16 single_step_vs_trajectory).
architectures.intervention_type: reject or clip at the decision instant (H1/H2/H3).
failure_modes: misses delayed tank-drawdown collapse that only materialises later in the horizon;
an absolute floor is ill-posed above the baseline worst node (~4.16 psi).
architectures.main_unresolved_issue: blind to delayed deterioration; well-posed absolute floor sits below the useful range.

architectures.name: Rolling Short-Horizon Look-Ahead (absolute floor over t+1..t+H)
architectures.composition: Evaluate TS1 (absolute worst-node floor) over a finite forward window of H control steps.
architectures.decision_information: worst-node pressure at each of H forward instants (H look-ahead solves).
architectures.look_ahead_dependence: finite H; behaviour depends strongly on H (see horizon_analysis).
architectures.tank_state_dependence: captures tank drawdown only within the H-step window.
architectures.baseline_compatibility: inherits S1 ill-posedness: theta_p >= ~4.16 psi flags the chronic baseline.
architectures.tested_severe_corner_behaviour: TS1 theta_p=5 worst-over-window is 5.4615/5.4045/5.3083/5.1472 psi at H=1/2/4/8 (does NOT activate) and 1.2947 psi at full (activates) - WU-16 temporal_rule_outputs.
architectures.delayed_collapse_visibility: sees the collapse only if H reaches the (untested) onset between H=8 (4 h) and full (96 h).
architectures.compute_cost_per_decision: H forward solves (linear; full=192x single-step, WU-16 per_horizon_lookahead_cost).
architectures.intervention_type: reject or clip when the window floor is breached.
failure_modes: short H misses the delayed collapse; long H is costly and still absolute-threshold ill-posed;
the H at which the severe corner is caught under a well-posed theta_p is UNTESTED.
architectures.main_unresolved_issue: horizon length vs cost vs absolute-threshold well-posedness are coupled and unresolved.

architectures.name: Look-Ahead + State-Degradation (finite window + relative rule)
architectures.composition: Evaluate TS2 (worst-node degradation) and/or TS3 (aggregate-deficit increase) over H steps vs the aligned baseline trajectory.
architectures.decision_information: post-action AND aligned-baseline worst-node/deficit over H forward instants.
architectures.look_ahead_dependence: finite H; the relative rule reacts even at H=1 on the tested corner.
architectures.tank_state_dependence: compares post-action vs baseline tank trajectories over the window.
architectures.baseline_compatibility: well-posed: relative rules do not flag the chronic baseline (identity hold -> no activation at eps=0).
architectures.tested_severe_corner_behaviour: TS2 eps_p=0 activates at H=1 (worst dp_min ~ -0.0968 psi) through full (~ -4.3007 psi) - reacts at short horizon (WU-16); S3 aggregate can mask localised collapse (WU-14 note; deficit<->leak corr -0.7735).
architectures.delayed_collapse_visibility: detects worsening-vs-baseline early, but a RELATIVE rule gives no ABSOLUTE min-pressure guarantee.
architectures.compute_cost_per_decision: H forward solves for the action + aligned baseline trajectory (WU-16).
architectures.intervention_type: reject or clip on relative degradation beyond tolerance.
failure_modes: relative rule cannot enforce an absolute floor;
aggregate deficit (S3/TS3) can mask a localised worst-node collapse.
architectures.main_unresolved_issue: provides no absolute guarantee; tolerance eps and horizon H are unset.

architectures.name: Backstop + Temporal (negative-pressure gate LAYERED with temporal/degradation check)
architectures.composition: Layer S4/TS4 immediate negative-pressure hard backstop WITH a temporal TS1/TS2/TS3 check over H.
architectures.decision_information: post negative-node count (immediate) PLUS windowed worst-node/deficit over H.
architectures.look_ahead_dependence: backstop is immediate (H=0); the temporal layer adds finite H.
architectures.threshold_dependence: negative gate (fixed, evidence-supported) PLUS theta_p/eps_p/eps_D for the temporal layer.
architectures.tank_state_dependence: temporal layer captures drawdown within H; backstop is instantaneous.
architectures.baseline_compatibility: S4 backstop never fires on the baseline (0 negatives); temporal relative layer also baseline-safe.
architectures.tested_severe_corner_behaviour: TS4 negative backstop NEVER activates on any tested corner (max_N_neg=0 including the 1.2947 psi collapse); the temporal layer supplies the non-negative protection.
architectures.delayed_collapse_visibility: the temporal layer inherits its window's visibility; the backstop only catches sub-zero.
architectures.compute_cost_per_decision: 1 solve for the backstop PLUS H solves for the temporal layer.
architectures.intervention_type: hard reject on negative pressure; reject/clip on temporal-layer breach.
failure_modes: the negative backstop alone gives NO 20-psi protection (never fires above 0 psi);
overall protection depends entirely on the temporal layer's metric/threshold/horizon choices.
architectures.main_unresolved_issue: the backstop is well-posed but inert in-range; the layered temporal rule still needs A/B/C/D decisions.

decision_matrix.note: Descriptive comparison only; rows are NOT ordered or marked; no metric is aggregated into a single figure.

K1_backstop_plus_relative.conceptual_stress_test: S4 negative backstop is INERT on every tested corner (max_N_neg=0 including the 1.2946763038635254 psi collapse), so protection rests entirely on the layered TS2 relative rule; TS2 eps_p=0 activates from H=1 on the severe corner. Failure surface: if TS2 threshold/horizon is mis-set the backstop adds NO 20-psi protection.

K2_aggregate_deficit_lookahead.conceptual_stress_test: TS3 aggregate deficit is baseline-safe but can MASK a localised worst-node collapse: aggregate D and worst-node p_min are only weakly anti-correlated (deficit<->leak corr -0.7735 in WU-14). On the tested corner D_max rises to 31.727617263793945 while p_min falls to 1.2946763038635254 psi; an aggregate tolerance could pass a step whose single worst node has collapsed.

K3_immediate_well_posed_absolute.conceptual_stress_test: S1 at the decision instant reads 5.527866840362549 psi on the severe corner and NEVER sees the 1.2946763038635254 psi 96 h collapse (H=0 blindness). A well-posed absolute floor must sit strictly below the baseline worst node ~4.16452169418335 psi, so it cannot enforce a useful 20-psi floor without flagging the chronic baseline.

K4_rolling_absolute_lookahead.conceptual_stress_test: TS1 theta_p=5 does NOT activate for H in {1,2,4,8} (worst-over-window 5.4615/5.4045/5.3083/5.1472 psi) and activates only once the window reaches the persisted crossover at report_index 13 (6.5 h); it inherits S1 ill-posedness above ~4.16452169418335 psi. CORRECTION vs WU-17: the onset is PERSISTED (not untested) via first_report_index_below_theta_p.

horizon_analysis.note: WU-17 horizon_analysis reproduced verbatim, then CORRECTED: the delayed collapse onset IS persisted in WU-16 (not untested).

wu17_horizon_analysis_verbatim.tested_command: prv_lower_pump_lower (severe lower-corner; R1b single characterised corner)
wu17_horizon_analysis_verbatim.observed_pattern: The severe corner reads 5.527866840362549 psi worst-node at the decision instant and 5.461512565612793 / 5.404520511627197 / 5.308281421661377 / 5.147222042083740 psi over H=1/2/4/8 (0.5-4 h), then collapses to 1.2946763038635254 psi at report index 192 (96 h) as the tanks drain. An absolute floor TS1 at theta_p=5 therefore does NOT activate for any tested finite H<=8 but DOES activate over the full horizon; a relative-degradation rule TS2 at eps_p=0 activates from H=1 onward.

crossover_interval_untested.statement: Under a well-posed absolute floor, the horizon at which the severe collapse is first caught lies strictly between H=8 (4 h) and full (96 h). The exact onset index is NOT persisted as a per-index p_min series in the STEP-9 artefacts, so intermediate horizons (e.g. 16/24/48/96 control steps) are UNTESTED.
crossover_interval_untested.conditional_open_item: Testing intermediate horizons is required ONLY IF the researcher selects an absolute-threshold look-ahead architecture (B) AND wants the smallest sufficient H. A relative-degradation architecture (C) already reacts at H=1 on this corner and needs no such test. This is a conditional design question, NOT a pending experiment mandated by this brief.

wu17_horizon_analysis_verbatim.cost_coupling: Look-ahead cost is linear in H (H forward solves per decision; full = 192x the single-step cost, WU-16 per_horizon_lookahead_cost). Longer horizons buy delayed-collapse visibility at proportional per-decision cost.
wu17_horizon_analysis_verbatim.interdependency: Metric choice, threshold well-posedness, and required horizon are COUPLED: an absolute floor needs a long horizon to catch this corner but is ill-posed above ~4.16 psi; a relative rule reacts at short horizon but gives no absolute guarantee.

crossover_onset_correction.reason: WU-16 persists the full per-report-index worst-node series (delayed_collapse_case.series.p_min_psi) and the first-crossing index per theta_p. The onset is therefore KNOWN, not untested.

severe_corner_smallest_sufficient_H_for_.interpretation: On the severe prv_lower_pump_lower corner an absolute floor at theta_p=5 psi is first breached at report index 13 (6.5 h). A rolling window (arch B) must reach H>=13 control steps to catch this corner under theta_p=5.

crossover_onset_correction.residual_genuine_gap: Only the temporal RULE-ACTIVATION booleans were tabulated at coarse H in {1,2,4,8,192}. Intermediate thresholds 5<theta_p<10 and non-severe action corners are not swept. Both are COMPUTABLE from the persisted series without new EPANET runs; neither is a STEP-9 blocker.

threshold_analysis.principle: No threshold is invented or selected. Each is a swept provisional grid value, an evidence-supported gate, or explicitly 'THRESHOLD NOT YET EMPIRICALLY JUSTIFIED'.

negative_pressure_gate.label: EVIDENCE-SUPPORTED
negative_pressure_gate.basis: Baseline holds max_N_neg=0 across the full 96 h horizon on every tested corner; the only well-posed hard absolute gate that never flags the baseline.

absolute_floor_theta_p_psi.label: PROVISIONAL - swept, not selected
absolute_floor_theta_p_psi.well_posedness_rule: A well-posed absolute floor must sit STRICTLY BELOW the baseline worst node (4.16452169418335 psi); otherwise it flags the chronic native baseline at some instant. theta_p=0 degenerates to the negative-pressure gate (S4). theta_p in {5,10,15,20} all exceed the baseline worst node and are therefore ill-posed as baseline-compatible absolute floors.
absolute_floor_theta_p_psi.useful_20psi_floor_reason: A 20-psi absolute floor is NOT empirically justifiable as baseline-compatible: 386 baseline node-timesteps sit below 20 psi (WU-14).

relative_degradation_eps_p_psi.label: PROVISIONAL - swept, not selected
relative_degradation_eps_p_psi.basis: Relative rule is baseline-safe (identity hold -> no activation at eps_p=0). Exact operating eps_p is a researcher value judgement; THRESHOLD NOT YET EMPIRICALLY JUSTIFIED for any single value.

aggregate_deficit_eps_D_psi_nodesum.label: PROVISIONAL - swept, not selected
aggregate_deficit_eps_D_psi_nodesum.basis: Relative aggregate rule is baseline-safe but can mask localised collapse; exact eps_D is THRESHOLD NOT YET EMPIRICALLY JUSTIFIED.

clip_alpha_H2.label: PROVISIONAL - coarse grid, not selected
clip_alpha_H2.basis: Interpolation fraction toward a_prev; one solve per inspected alpha (WU-15).

threshold_analysis.summary: The ONLY evidence-supported hard threshold is the negative-pressure gate N_neg==0. All pressure/deficit tolerances remain PROVISIONAL; a useful absolute 20-psi floor is THRESHOLD NOT YET EMPIRICALLY JUSTIFIED as baseline-compatible.

action_handling_analysis.note: H1/H2/H3 are NOT selected. Handling policies copied verbatim from WU-17; framing is descriptive, not ordered.

H1_reject_to_previous.definition: On an inadmissible action, execute the previous action a_prev instead.

H2_clip_toward_previous.definition: Interpolate a_exec = a_prev + alpha*(a_prop - a_prev) toward previous by an admissible alpha.
H2_clip_toward_previous.continuity: continuous under clip (preserves a continuous action image).
H2_clip_toward_previous.extra_hydraulic_evals: one solve per inspected alpha (WU-15 h2_alpha_grid_evals_per_transition=5).

H3_fallback_reference_action.definition: On an inadmissible action, execute a documented fallback (reference_nominal native PRV/pump setpoints).

handling_policies.note: Handling outputs are copied verbatim from WU-15. On the reference->severe transition H1/H3 reject the full-lower proposal (action_deviation_L2=2.4050194704019527) to a_prev/fallback; H2 admissible alpha is per-rule. No policy is selected.

framing.H1_reject_to_previous: discontinuous; 0 extra solves; executed=a_prev on breach.
framing.H2_clip_toward_previous: continuous action image (PPO-friendly); one solve per inspected alpha on the {0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0} grid.
framing.shared_consequence: Every policy makes executed != proposed on intervention, coupling to the effort-term train/execute decision (see train_execute_analysis).

train_execute_analysis.note: Copied verbatim from WU-17. The effort-term integration is FLAGGED, not decided; the frozen reward definition is untouched.

ppo_compatibility_wu16.note: PPO is model-free: the env need not be differentiable. A clip/reject guard makes executed != commanded, so the train/execute gap must be observable to the policy. Latency is wall-clock, not learning-theoretic.

train_execute_analysis.proposed_vs_executed_mismatch: Any intervention (reject H1 / clip H2 / fallback H3) makes the executed action differ from the policy's proposed action. WU-15 measures action_deviation_L2=2.4050194704019527 on the reference->severe reject.
train_execute_analysis.effort_term_open_question: The FROZEN reward effort term ||da||^2 is defined on the COMMANDED action. Under an intervention, commanded (proposed) != executed. Whether the effort term (and the env transition) uses the proposed or the executed action is a training-integration decision COUPLED to the handling policy; it is flagged here, NOT decided, and does not modify the frozen reward definition.
train_execute_analysis.continuity: Clip (H2) preserves a continuous action image (PPO-friendly); reject/fallback (H1/H3) are discontinuous. The safety layer need not be differentiable (WU-15 PPO_compatibility).
train_execute_analysis.interval: All candidates are compatible with the 30-min control interval (WU-15).
train_execute_analysis.carried_into_d_p6_006: The proposed-vs-executed effort-term convention is a training-integration decision COUPLED to the handling policy. It is a D-P6-006 companion item, not a STEP-9 blocker, and does not modify D-P6-005.

repeated_intervention_analysis.note: Conceptual analysis of what happens under REPEATED admissibility interventions across consecutive control steps. Descriptive only; no new EPANET runs. No single mechanism is preferred.
repeated_intervention_analysis.H1_reject_to_previous_risk: Repeatedly rejecting to a_prev freezes the actuator at the last-admitted action. If that held action is itself on a slow tank-drawdown trajectory, repeated holds can COMPOUND toward the delayed collapse the immediate rule cannot see: the severe corner reads 5.527866840362549 psi at the decision instant but 1.2946763038635254 psi at 96 h.
repeated_intervention_analysis.H2_clip_risk: Repeated clipping toward a_prev keeps executed actions in a shrinking neighbourhood of the last admitted action; continuous but can stall policy exploration near a safe-but-suboptimal operating point.
repeated_intervention_analysis.H3_fallback_risk: Repeated fallback to reference_nominal repeatedly overrides the policy with the native setpoints; reference_nominal itself holds the chronic ~4.16 psi baseline worst node, i.e. the fallback is baseline-safe but not 20-psi safe.
repeated_intervention_analysis.backstop_interaction: A negative-pressure backstop (S4/TS4) is INERT on every tested corner (max_N_neg=0), so it does not bound repeated-intervention drift in-range; the temporal layer governs that behaviour.
repeated_intervention_analysis.mitigation_note: A look-ahead architecture (B/C/D) that inspects the forward window is the only characterised way to detect drawdown-driven compounding before it materialises; the required horizon is the persisted crossover (>=13 steps for theta_p=5 on the severe corner). This is design guidance, NOT a selection.
repeated_intervention_analysis.coverage_limit: Repeated-intervention dynamics are NOT empirically simulated (no closed-loop policy rollout in STEP-9); this is a reasoned risk map, deferred to STEP-12 testing.

final_provisional_designs.common_note: All three are implementable admissibility layers over the frozen action/observation/reward. None is selected, ranked, or scored; the researcher composes the final D-P6-006 design.

unresolved_issues.note: WU-17 uncertainties carried forward; the crossover item is corrected against disk.
items: No validated safe/unsafe oracle exists: activation counts are DESCRIPTIVE, not false-positive/false-negative rates (WU-15/WU-16).
R1b: only the single lower corner (prv_lower_pump_lower) has measured near-collapse; interior points, mixed PRV corners, and joint action x uncertain-demand space are UNCHARACTERISED.

SUPERSEDED: the delayed-collapse onset IS persisted (wu16.delayed_collapse_case.series.p_min_psi) and the theta_p=5 crossover is pinned at report_index 13 (6.5 h). Residual gap: temporal RULE activations tabulated only at coarse H in {1,2,4,8,192}; intermediate thresholds 5<theta_p<10 and non-severe corners are computable from the persisted series without new EPANET runs.
Sustained/horizon deltas include tank-trajectory divergence and are NOT a strict single-step look-ahead; only report index 0 is a pure command-effect one-step look-ahead (WU-15).
H2 alpha grid is coarse (0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0) and demonstrated on one transition only (WU-15).
The leakage emitter instrument is NOT field-calibrated; leak values are internally consistent evidence, not calibrated predictions.
Whether the frozen effort term uses the proposed or executed action under intervention is an open training-integration question coupled to the handling policy.
Thresholds theta_p/eps_p/eps_D are PROVISIONAL swept grids; the leakage<->service<->safety exchange rate they encode is a researcher value judgement, not a measured quantity.
